info.title: [VGE-D-SS06] Cardfight!! Vanguard Special Series 06: Stand Up Deckset “Gramgrace” ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
D-SS06/001EN
Sword Saint Knight Dragon, Gramgrace
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT](VC):Your persona ride also increases the [Power] of your back row units. [ACT](VC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], draw a card, choose a card from your hand, call it to back row center (RC), and until end of turn, that unit can attack from the back row, and gets [Power] +10000.
[AUTO](VC):At the end of the battle your back row center rear-guard attacked, put that unit into soul, and draw a card.

D-SS06/002EN
Divine Sister, Gateaubasque
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](VC):When you would ride from the ride deck, you may "[Soul-Blast 1]" instead of "Choose a card from hand, and discard it".

D-SS06/003EN
Incision Angel
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and discard it.

D-SS06/004EN
Starting Magic, Starlily
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-SS06/005EN
Knight of Soaring Blade, Ffernbael
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[AUTO]Back Row Center (RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & discard a card from hand], choose one of your vanguards with "Gramgrace" in its card name, and it gets [Power] +10000/drive +1 until end of turn.

D-SS06/006EN
Knight of War Damage, Fosado
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT](RC):This unit cannot be chosen by your opponent's card effects.
[AUTO](RC):When this unit's attack hits, [Counter-Charge 1]/[Soul-Charge 1].

D-SS06/007EN
Knight of Soaring Refinement, Dfyn
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When your grade 3 or greater unit in the center column attacks, if you have a vanguard with "Gramgrace" in its card name, that attacking unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO]Front Row (RC):When this unit attacks, if you have a vanguard with "Gramgrace" in its card name, and your units in the center column attacked two or more times this turn, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +15000 until end of that battle.

D-SS06/008EN
Knight of Piercing, Cadwalla
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked a vanguard, if you have four or more units, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & retire this unit], look at the top three cards of your deck, choose up to one grade 2 or greater unit card from among them, reveal it and put it into hand, and shuffle the deck. If you did not reveal a card, draw a card.

D-SS06/009EN
Divine Sister, Languedechat
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):If your soul has a grade 3 or greater card, this unit gets "Boost", and [Power] +5000. (Active on opponent's turn too)

D-SS06/010EN
Drilling Angel
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][put a unit card from drop into soul], look at the top three cards of your deck, choose up to one card with the same card name as the card put into soul for this cost from among them, call it to (RC), and shuffle the deck.

D-SS06/011EN
Knight of Gale, Cyneblugar
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, this unit gets [Power] +5000.

D-SS06/012EN
Painkiller Angel
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit boosted, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 & retire this unit], and draw a card.

D-SS06/013EN
Palladium Zeal Dragon
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle. If your hand has two or more cards, choose a card from hand, and discard it.

D-SS06/014EN
Light Dragon Deity of Honors, Amartinoa
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Until end of turn, you also perform drive checks for the battles your rear-guards attack!

D-SS06/015EN
Daring Knight, Sauel
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
-

White Fang Witch, Disma
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
-

Operating Angel
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
-

D-SS06/018EN
Palpitation Angel
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck)

D-SS06/019EN
Magic of Alteration, Turnarr
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked while boosted, if your damage zone has three or more face down cards, [COST][put this unit into soul], and [Counter-Charge 1].

D-SS06/020EN
Knight of Rendering Flash, Cairbre
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], look at the top three cards of your deck, choose a card from among them, reveal it, call it to (RC) if it is a grade 2 or less unit card, and put it into hand if it is not. Shuffle the deck.

D-SS06/021EN
Wayward Therapy Angel
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[CONT]:This card cannot be ridden, and cannot be normal called to (RC) from hand.
[AUTO]:When this card is discarded from hand during your turn, if your vanguard is grade 3 or greater, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], and call this card to a back row (RC).

D-SS06/022EN
Bringer of Soaring Wind, Lachte
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]Back Row (RC):At the end of your turn, if you have a vanguard with "Gramgrace" in its card name, [COST][retire this unit], choose a grade 3 unit card from your soul, and put it into hand.

D-SS06/023EN
Gratias Gradale
Normal Order｜ -｜ Grade 3｜ Power ｜ Shield
Regalis Piece(You may only have one Regalis Piece in your deck, and use it a total of one time in a fight)
Play this if you have a grade 3 vanguard with persona ride and you did not ride this turn!
Activate persona ride. (Draw a card, all of your front row units get [Power] +10000 this turn, and you are regarded to have persona rode)
